1 import Mathlib
2 
3 namespace SixVertexUnfolding
4 
5 abbrev Space := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)
6 abbrev Plane := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)
7 
8 -- Affine dimension: 1 for an edge, 2 for a face.
9 noncomputable def affineDimension (s : Set Space) : ℕ :=
10   Module.finrank ℝ (affineSpan ℝ s).direction
11 
12 -- A bounded, genuinely three-dimensional convex polyhedron.
13 structure ConvexPolyhedron where
14   vertices : Finset Space
15   solid : (interior (convexHull ℝ (vertices : Set Space))).Nonempty
16   vertices_exact :
17     (vertices : Set Space) =
18       (convexHull ℝ (vertices : Set Space)).extremePoints ℝ
19 
20 def ConvexPolyhedron.body (P : ConvexPolyhedron) : Set Space :=
21   convexHull ℝ (P.vertices : Set Space)
22 
23 -- A whole two-dimensional intersection with a supporting plane.
24 def ConvexPolyhedron.IsFace (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (F : Set Space) : Prop :=
25   affineDimension F = 2 ∧
26   ∃ (n : Space) (h : ℝ), n ≠ 0 ∧
27     (∀ x ∈ P.body, inner ℝ n x ≤ h) ∧
28     F = {x ∈ P.body | inner ℝ n x = h}
29 
30 -- ALL faces, each represented once by its set of points.
31 def ConvexPolyhedron.Face (P : ConvexPolyhedron) :=
32   {F : Set Space // P.IsFace F}
33 
34 -- Two distinct faces meet along an original edge exactly when
35 -- their intersection has affine dimension one.
36 def ConvexPolyhedron.ShareEdge (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (F G : P.Face) : Prop :=
37   affineDimension (F.val ∩ G.val) = 1
38 
39 structure EdgeUnfolding (P : ConvexPolyhedron) where
40   place : P.Face → Space → Plane
41   hinges : SimpleGraph P.Face
42   tree : hinges.IsTree
43   original_edges : ∀ F G, hinges.Adj F G → P.ShareEdge F G
44   rigid : ∀ F, ∀ x ∈ F.val, ∀ y ∈ F.val,
45     dist (place F x) (place F y) = dist x y
46   joined : ∀ F G, hinges.Adj F G → ∀ x ∈ F.val ∩ G.val,
47     place F x = place G x
48   nonoverlap : ∀ F G, F ≠ G →
49     Disjoint (interior (place F '' F.val))
50              (interior (place G '' G.val))
51 
52 def ConvexPolyhedron.HasEdgeUnfolding (P : ConvexPolyhedron) : Prop :=
53   Nonempty (EdgeUnfolding P)
54 
55 end SixVertexUnfolding
